bestBets.overview: NIGHT BROKER was well supported in the betting on debut but he put in a shocker and was beaten by a space. The trainer suggested he may have choked down in the run so the tongue tie goes on and W Pike retains the ride. XELCIMUS has shown ability previously and attacks this fresh with the benefit of a nice trial effort. PLAYING SOLO showed ability in his initial preparation and attacks this fresh with the benefit of two nice trial efforts. MERCHANT TRADER has trialled very for his return.

raceTips.comment: Rollwiththepunches was really supported in betting last start at Northam off one of the better second last efforts on debut you’ll see and he would’ve slept incredibly well with the run he had. Finally draws a barrier for the first time in his career and this looks a much better set-up for him to put his best foot forward, trials prior to his debut were elite. Buttering up again with him and more than happy to at the price available as well. Playing Solo is a lightly raced 3YO resuming post gelding op for a Dan Morton yard who will have some bullets to fire come carnival time in the 3YO space. Trialled well for his return and the last time we saw him at the races he chased home hard into 2nd behind Clear Approval in a 2YO 0MW contest over 1400m. Good draw to work with for CJP, back into maiden company for the first time in his career and looks to have plenty of upside despite the fact his best in time will likely be over a bit further than the six furlongs. Merchant Trader didn’t fire a shot on race-day in his initial campaign of racing but showed real promise at the trials prior to his debut and has done so again leading into his return here, skipped away from his rivals down at Lark Hill and bolted in. Map looks a bit sticky but this could be the prep where we see something. Kute As Kan Be can kick through to hold the top under the 50.5kgs and try to skip clear on the corner.

bestBets.overview: BOUTIQUE BELLE has shown ability previously and attacks this first-up with the benefit of a nice trial win. She draws the inside and W Pike rides. BLUE SPARX has run well in both career starts and the winkers go on. DAMAGE CONTROL ran on well last start. PERFUME PRINCESS next best.

raceTips.comment:
Blue Sparx has hit the line super in both career runs to date this prep and drops weight off his back into this all aged maiden where he can park up close handy in a race that really lacks any natural speed influences on paper. The race he comes out of last start has already been a winner producing event through Raw Umber and think if he holds his form he looks very hard to beat in this, talented type. Boutique Belle can win on return but think she’s short at $2.60. Like some of the form around her runs last campaign where she was solid without being world-beating, recent trial again was good enough and it wouldn’t surprise given the lack of speed engaged in this if William Pike was intent on kicking through to lead from that inside peg and keeping her out of any trouble. Have struggled to get a grasp on her across her career to date. Damage Control is low flying but he’s back in trip and drawn a lemon, just going to keep him in the back pocket for the time being and wait till we can potentially strike later in 
the prep. Wrexham has some tricks but he'll bob up soon, still working it all out.

bestBets.overview: HEZ GOT THE SAFE has found the line well in both starts this time in. He does find it hard to win but this looks the weakest race he has competed in for a while and he goes close despite the 61.5kg impost. BRINSON is an interesting runner. She has shown ability in Victoria and makes her local debut on the back of an impressive trial win and W Pike rides. DON'T WINK ran well first-up. She improves off that effort and runs well. MODERN GIRL shook her maiden tag with a dominant last start all the way win.

raceTips.comment: Modern Girl has burst onto the scene this prep as a sprinting filly who looks like she’ll be able to really work through the grades. First up drew 12 of 12 at Bunbury, sat deep and stuck on well to be beaten only by Sunset Session in a high rating contest before absolutely bolting in as an odds-on pop from the top last start stopping the clock almost 8L faster than maiden class average over the 1000m. It was a seriously impressive display of speed and expect she’ll be more than measuring up in this CL1 here potentially on the way to some stronger races moving forward. Don’t Wink attacked the line really well on return when just unable to reel in the very speedy Snip Of Romance. She’s drawn widest here which probably isn’t ideal but she’ll be winding up strongly late in the piece. Brinson brings intrigue as a very nicely bred, lightly raced 4YO mare making her WA debut for Brandon Fiore off a stylish trial victory at Lark Hill. Has got good tactical speed, was a Yarra Valley maiden winner over 1200m back in December of last year and has the services of William Pike in the saddle for her first outing here drawn beautifully. Big market watch. G’day Bloke was a great first run for Summer Dickson.

bestBets.overview: PURE MAC battled on well after parking wide throughout first-up. He improves off that and will appreciate the rise in trip. POINT GIBRALTOR shook his maiden tag with a dominant last start win. If he can repeat that effort he goes close again. SOLO VEGA has found the line well in both starts this time in. BACK TO BONDI next best.

raceTips.comment: Back To Bondi gives the impression he’s ready to win. Been racing solely in CL3 company since he was run off his legs first up at 1200m and his last 2 have both been really solid efforts in defeat. Can roll forward in a race that lacks real genuine speed influences, drops back to CL1 company, great use of the Holly Nottle claim and having his fifth run back for the campaign now you know he’s going to be rock-hard fit. Always had time for hm and this is comfortably the most suitable race he’s found this campaign, love the intent off the quick spin too. Pure Mac is back sharply in class as well off a really solid first up effort in 0MW company over a distance short of his best at 1300m where he endured a wide trip throughout but still stuck on really well. Straight to 1650m second up should suit and Jefferson Tsang riding in great form at the moment. 3rd in a Lex Piper over a mile late last prep behind The Crimson Pirate, terrific form for this. Solo Vega should’ve finished closer last start after encountering an impeded passage in the straight and that was off the back of a slashing 2nd from last on return at Pinjarra, she’s returned in very good order this campaign. Point Gibraltar has some upside, dominant maiden win last start and while this is a lot tougher and he has to do it with more weight on his back he’s nicely bred and he’s lightly raced.

bestBets.overview: MUST BE NICE went to Kalgoorlie last start and posted a strong win. This looks a fairly soft race and expecting him to measure up. AWESOME FORCE found the line well Pinjarra and should appreciate the rise in trip. HANAFUBUKI had excuses in her local debut. She did attack that race first-up over a mile without a trial so no surprise to see her improve sharply on that run. DELICATE WARRIOR next best.

raceTips.comment: Awesome Force has been racing like a horse crying out for ground all campaign and finally gets his crack now that he’s rock-hard fit out to the 2100m. Loved the way he finished off late once clear at 1800m behind a progressive one in Lets Take A Chance, will just come down to whether or not Joey Azzopardi can just gift him the right flowing run into the race given he is likely to get right back from his gate. Genuine each-way chance in a race which should be just about each-way the field all the way through betting. Hot Like Chili isn’t very trustworthy given she’s 1/30 in her career to date but her last two efforts would be good enough to win this. Banging the door down. Must Be Nice has more wins in store as an animal whose ceiling may not yet have been reached. Had to be put into the race a mile from home last start at Kalgoorlie and was still too powerful for his rivals late, big lump of an animal who can really sustain a gallop. Delicate Warrior broke maiden status over the staying trip very softly last start and had been racing very well in some handy middle distance maiden company prior to that. Great use of the Nottle claim too.

bestBets.overview: HURRICANE HARLEY is a handy type who attacks this fresh off a ten week let-up. He rolls forward from a good draw and gives a kick. POBLANO is rock hard fit, racing well and Pike retains the ride. DIVINE INANNA will appreciate the drop in grade. CHAMPAGNE CRUSADER should be peaking at his fourth run back from a spell.

raceTips.comment: Hurricane Harley resumes off a 10 week break for a yard who is known for producing them fresh with a bang. Won a 3YO 0MW at 1200m under 59kgs before a break courtesy of an Austin Galati special and posted a figure in that win more than good enough to be taking this out. Inconsistency has littered his career to date but from what we have seen, he’s versatile and his best is Saturday quality. Poblano drops back to 1200m and should get the right run she needs from the draw to be in the finish once again. Can’t get her as short as she is in the market (looks a bit of Pike tax) but she hasn’t lost any admirers at her previous couple without winning. Pike sticks and she’ll be ready to present on straightening if good enough. Champagne Crusader is going to need a lot to go right from the gate but do feel 1200m suits him better. Fantaxtic was too bad to be true first up, trialled super.

bestBets.overview: BOUSSAC had no luck first-up. He drew wide, settled at the rear and met plenty of interference in the straight. He draws the inside in this and Clint Johnston-Porter goes on. THE ROCKET attacks this off a dominant maiden win. No surprise to see him go on with the job. ACTA NON VERBA failed to fire in his local debut. He should improve off that run and has claims. YOU CAN CALL ME AL next best.

raceTips.comment: Very tricky race. Classic Ruler gets the services of Pike and that booking for the kind of horse he is can’t be understated. Was brave two start ago taking out a 1300m CL3 at Northam which has since proven to be a really strong form reference and last start did a mountain of work ridden closer than usual settling outside the lead when sticking out well to run 4th not beaten all that far. Better ridden quieter, can settle off speed here and come with a run with the right man for the job in the chair. The Rocket belted them courtesy of a Chris Parnham 12/10 last start and when he lobbed where he was able to in the run from where he drew it was all over. Now has a 3kg claimer from a slightly sticky gate but doesn’t look to be a huge amount of speed and should be able to still push forward and find a spot. Again, like a couple on this program just think he’s well enough found at close to even money? You Can Call Me Al never saw daylight in the straight last start, love the Lucy Fiore booking, he’ll get back and look for that three wide moving line and come with a run. Olaf The Snowman finally broke through last start after threatening to for a while, can go on with it now, has some tricks and doesn’t look an easy horse to ride but always felt he was a talented animal.

bestBets.overview: ZEEZEA improved sharply second-up to post an impressive win at this track and distance. This doesn't look any harder and if she repeats that effort she goes close again. COSMIC SPIRIT ran well below par last start. The blinkers go on as does W Pike so expecting some sharp improvement. ADMIRE THE GIRL has been sound all preparation. ARTIE'S STORM next best.

raceTips.comment: This race just has a three deep cover, blending in, finishing off over the top feel to it and that’s exactly the run I’m envisioning Cosmic Spirit might get under Pike in the last. Thought she was terrific first up in a winner producing CL3 at Northam off that well-documented long layoff before a run that was riddled with excuses second up under the apprentice. Pike back on, blinkers on first time and think if she can land somewhere in that three wide line and be stalking them on the corner she can blouse them late. Artie’s Storm fought on well despite being well held at Northam last start behind Flying Maradona (subsequently run well in Saturday company) and Marcos in a strongly run race and can box-seat from 1 here. Third up now should be ready to rumble. Zeezea won really well second run back after Galati gave her the gun in transit but the map does look very sticky here to my eye, going to need some luck to get in but was authoritative and it is good use of the Nottle claim to only half a kilo in the same grade off a win. Cantrix drew 15 of 15 last start and should have finished a heck of a lot closer, building quite nicely into her campaign and can make her presence felt here.
